gallery.title: File:All England Lawn Tennis Ground 1938.jpg
gallery.description: Debenture of the All England Lawn Tennis Ground Limited for £50, issued on 10 September 1938. Since 1920, these Wimbledon Debentures have been sold to tennis fans to raise funds for capital expenditure. Each Debenture buys a pair of tickets to each Wimbledon tournament day for five years. They can be redeemed at par at the end of the fifth year.

gallery.filename: Right side of Centre Court, Wimbledon.jpg
gallery.title: File:Right side of Centre Court, Wimbledon.jpg
gallery.description: A shot of the Wimbledon Centre Court on the right hand side. The tournament had concluded, and you can see the covered royal box, uncut grass, and, in the distance, the scoreboard of Novak Djokovic and Carlos Alcaraz, who played the Wimbledon 2023 final.
